description: Turn a plain-language monitoring request into an EQL query. Costs 1 credit plus LLM usage. This only drafts the query, nothing starts running until you activate it with auto_query_write. Say what to watch, the threshold, and what should happen when it fires.

message.description: What to monitor, in plain language, for example "tell me on Telegram when BTC funding on Binance goes negative".

sessionId.description: Continue refining a query from an earlier reply.

speed.description: fast is cheaper, expert reasons more deeply about the query.

name: auto_build
title: Auto query builder
